highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, new image-filter APIs, and faster CPU blur rendering.
highlights_body: Paint bounds and overdraw visualization make drawing diagnostics easier. Existing pre-v4 deprecations now require migration, and the deprecated notebook integration is no longer included.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs become compile errors
breaking.body: Replace sampleCount-based Vulkan/Metal GRBackendRenderTarget constructors with their counterparts without sampleCount. Use run-buffer Glyphs and Positions properties instead of obsolete span accessors, SKFontHinting instead of SKPaintHinting, and SKSamplingOptions instead of SKFilterQuality. The obsolete enum types remain in implementation assemblies for ABI compatibility but are absent from reference assemblies.

breaking.title: Notebook integration no longer ships
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp NuGet package no longer embeds its deprecated .NET Interactive/Polyglot Notebooks extension. Notebook consumers must provide their own rendering integration rather than rely on the removed extension.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from m148 while preserving PDF support on Tizen and the existing Windows runtime floor.
Includes AAT and Arabic fallback-shaping corrections, COLR v1 fixes, and glyph-extents improvements.
CreateCrop restricts filter output with a rectangle and tile mode; CreateEmpty discards input to transparent black.
SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns conservative bounds when available for quick-reject culling. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a caller-supplied six-color palette.
Small-sigma blurs of 8888 images use the faster dedicated approximation path instead of the regressed raster-pipeline path.
Corrects a native data race between opening and reusing a CoreText-backed typeface stream.

bullets.lead: Surface canvas access avoids repeated interop
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper across calls and recreates the wrapper if it was explicitly disposed.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the v4 deprecation pass, cached surface canvas wrappers, and restored small-sigma CPU blur performance

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with Skia m150.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the pre-v4 deprecation pass, and retired notebook integration.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate added crop and empty image filters, paint bounds and overdraw diagnostics, and restored CPU blur performance.

harfbuzz_summary: The HarfBuzzSharp test suite moves to xUnit v3; this collected HarfBuzz-specific work does not introduce new shaping APIs.
